deviations.what: The base window is built as fy + 0:(base_years - 1), so a class filed in year fy counts toward focal years fy to fy+4 instead of fy+1 to fy+5, which wrongly puts year t itself (rule 6) in the base and drops the t-5 filings from the base (rule 4).

notes: The forward window (line 18), the anti-join for new classes (line 22), the empty-base NA rule (line 31), the no-forward rule (line 30), firm separation through the joins, and the dedup and output columns (lines 24-32) match the spec. Treating an empty-string subclass as missing (line 12) is an unstated but reasonable reading and is not counted as a deviation.
